modules.certificationNote: TB-TMAR-CART-AMSC-001-W3 (tooba-architecture-certify) certified the Cart module under ARCH-COMPLETE-002: verdict COMPLETE_REFERENCE_PATTERN. W2: Application is capability-first (Application/Carts/{Commands,Queries,Validators}); the technical axes Commands/Queries/Models are forbidden at the Application root and the Models tombstone is deleted. W1: fault identity is SemanticException(new SemanticError(code)) via CartOperation; CartErrorCodes lives in Tooba.Cart.Contracts.Errors; CartDirectory decomposed 831 -> 602 LOC. W3 verified: path<->namespace EXACT, root allowlists ENFORCED, 7 module-owned routes with zero Host HTTP ownership, 7 endpoint-reachable requests each IRequest/IRequestHandler dispatched through ISender, validator coverage 4 REQUIRED + 3 NO_VALIDATOR_REQUIRED, canonical ApiResponseFactory/SafeErrorMapper result mapping with zero raw Results.*, 27 stable Cart codes with 26 module-owned descriptors and the shared checkout.authentication_required consumed-not-registered, both-culture resx coverage, unchanged migrations, and cross-module coupling limited to approved Contracts edges (Catalog/Inventory/Offer/Pricing/Party/StoreContext) with zero foreign Application/Infrastructure/Domain dependency. Behavior, routes, DTO shapes, error-code values, resources and schema were preserved by W3 itself (W3 introduced zero runtime behavior change). Truth correction (W3-R1): the complete AMSC-001 did contain one accepted bounded expected-failure repair, owned by W1 — previously unexpected/defective failure paths (domain/infrastructure guard trips, pricing-with-no-quote, unresolved store-commerce context) moved from HTTP 500 platform.unexpected to catalogued typed/localized HTTP 400/409/503 (cart.* codes); success payloads, previously-mapped expected failures, routes, DTO shapes and schema were unchanged. Error-code ownership truth: CartErrorCodes declares 27 boundary codes, CartErrorCatalogContributor registers 26 descriptors, and the shared checkout.authentication_required is Foundation-owned and consumed-not-registered by Cart. Truth repair (W3-R2): the previously unregistered reachable code cart.line.currency_missing now has exactly one Cart-registered descriptor (Business/409, mirroring cart.pricing.quote_missing), so no reachable Cart-owned code falls back to platform.unexpected; zero duplicate descriptor ownership remains.
